method: Per take: duration/ending (RMS envelope), mid-song gaps (<-45 dBFS >2s), sample peak + clipped samples, integrated LUFS (pyloudnorm), tempo (librosa beat tracking, half/double/2:3 allowed), vocal stem via demucs htdemucs (coverage, pitch), lyrics via faster-whisper small.en on the mix in 90s windows plus a VAD pass on the vocal stem when recall was low; line recall = share of lyric lines (>=3 words) fuzzy-matched >=0.6. Whisper struggles with sung/shouted rock vocals, so low lyric recall is a warning, not proof of missing lyrics.
